# parilka-unified

> TypeScript runtime for Parilka: MTProto history owner, durable Telegram Bot
> API owner, direct OpenAI Responses loop, local SQLite/BGE-M3 retrieval,
> loopback MCP and digest/Dream jobs. Read `AGENTS.md` first.

## Start here

- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): safety, ownership and verification rules.
- [Architecture index](docs/README.md): current architecture and ADRs.
- [Operations](operations/README.md): staged preflight, cutover and rollback.

## Runtime owners

- `src/bot/`, `src/bot-daemon/`: durable Bot API lifecycle, direct Responses
  request loop, direct image input, typing/progress/rich publication and five
  host-managed read-only history tools.
- `src/openai-responses/`: narrow official-SDK transport. Bot requests are
  hard-pinned to `gpt-5.6-luna` and `service_tier: "fast"`, with hosted web
  search on every bot request.
- `src/bot/causal-rag/`, `src/vector/`, `src/embeddings.ts`: causal bounded
  packet plus loopback BGE-M3 dense/sparse retrieval, RRF and local rerank.
- `src/storage/`: one SQLite connection/transaction kernel and durable state.
- `src/sync/`, `src/telegram/`: sole MTProto owner, sync and transports.
- `src/mcp-tools/`, `src/mcp-loopback.ts`: operator MCP and loopback proxy.
- `src/digest/`, `src/dream/`, `src/digest-cli/`: bounded day/week generation
  and Dream through the direct Responses maintenance boundary.
- `src/maintenance/`: retention, FTS/WAL maintenance and integrity checks.

## Non-negotiable bot boundary

The model has hosted web search/open/find, trusted image input and exactly five
local read functions: `rag_bm25_search`, `keyword_search`, `read_chat_slice`,
`day_digest`, `thread_context`. It has no terminal, filesystem mutation,
Telegram write or generic host tools. Host-injected causal cutoff is always
`message_id < trigger`.

## Workflow

- Run focused tests, then `npm run check`, `npm run check:architecture`, shell
  and systemd checks, build/tests, and `git diff --check` for a completed slice.
- While the old owner still executes `dist/`, use `npm run verify:responses`;
  it activates an immutable direct-Responses release only after offline gates.
- `loop-develop/history/` is immutable historical evidence. In particular,
  `006-native-codex-cutover` documents the retired Codex deployment; do not
  treat it as Responses E2E evidence.
- Direct Responses deployment remains staged until the operator performs the
  explicit single-owner procedure in [operations/RESPONSES.md](operations/RESPONSES.md).
